messages:
Ana: Quick quarterly pulse — sharing a short ship snapshot for OKR A1 (runtime latency & batcher). Please reply with shipped/slipped + owner + blocker (if any).

Ana: TL;DR I think: runtime v2 canary shipped, client batching on 4 endpoints slipped, eval regressions caught on reranker.

Kevin: Shipped: runtime v2 canary (service/runtime) — owner Kevin. No major regressions. Deployed to us-east-1 at 10:15 PT.

Ria: Slipped: client batching for embeddings SDK. Owner Ria. Blocker: API surface changes require one more SDK major bump; ETA EOW. @Kevin FYI for compat test.

Tom: Shipped: console per-route latency dashboard. Owner Tom. Need product to confirm calc method for p50/p95.

Maya: Slipped: reranker calibration. Owner Maya. Eval set showed 4% delta vs baseline. Root cause: tokenization mismatch. Working on patch, ETA +5 days.

Jules: Dep: infra needs kernel update before rolling quantized model to dedicated pools. Owner Jules. Infra team scheduled maintenance Thu 06:00 UTC. If that slips, model rollout delayed.

Ana: @Ria can you post the SDK PR link and the failing test? We can triage async.

Ria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/412 — failing test `test_batching_endpoint_compat`. Error snippet:
```
AssertionError: expected headers to include `x-rdwd-client` but got none
```

Kevin: Quick note: the canary was routed 10% traffic; fallback policy worked once for ~3m during GC. deploy-bot: bump.

deploy-bot: Deployment runtime-v2-canary completed: 1768888920. No active incidents.

Ana: Actions:
- Ria: fix SDK compat test & open patch (ETA EOW)
- Maya: reranker tokenization patch + small eval run (ETA 5 days)
- Jules: confirm infra kernel window or propose fallback (ETA 24h)
- Tom: finalize dashboard calc and ping analytics for signoff (ETA 48h)

Tom: I'll add the dashboard calc doc to the milestone board and ping @analytics.

Jules: If infra window slips, fallback is to restrict model rollout to dedicated non-quantized nodes — I can do that in ~2h.

Ana: Ok good. Can owners add a quick status update by EOD PST? We'll compile for next week's OKR review.

Maya: Will add interim eval numbers by EOD. :white_check_mark:

Ria: Working on PR now, will post update with tests passing.

Kevin: Noted, will monitor canary and share perf graphs in #eng-runtime tomorrow morning.

Ana: Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with a short summary for execs after EOD. :raised_hands:
